name: atr_breakout_volatility_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY's 5-minute ATR expands above its own 10-minute baseline (ratio > 1.2) and price breaches a 2.0 * ATR channel anchored to the session VWAP, it signals that an institutional directional order — a large TWAP execution or a triggered stop cascade — is actively overwhelming resting passive liquidity. At 5-second resolution we enter within the first 1-2 bars of the breach, before most 1-minute momentum algorithms have confirmed the move on their bar close. The VWAP-anchored channel self-adjusts to the day's realized volatility, so the breakout threshold is statistically significant regardless of whether the session is calm (ATR 8 pts) or volatile (ATR 18 pts).

indicators.name: atr_60
indicators.formula: Wilder ATR(high, low, close, 60) on 5s bars
indicators.purpose: 5-minute ATR captures current intraday volatility. Original used ATR(14) on 1-min = 14-min lookback. Compressed to 5 min (60 bars at 5s) because our hold is 15-120s not 15-60 min — ATR must reflect CURRENT short-term volatility, not a 14-min lag. At 5s bars, a 14-min ATR would smooth away the very volatility expansion we are trying to detect.

indicators.name: atr_ratio
indicators.purpose: ATR expansion ratio comparing current 5-min ATR to its 10-minute rolling average. When > 1.2, short-term volatility is accelerating — a genuine expansion event, not a random noisy bar. The 120-bar (10-min) baseline is long enough to smooth within-session noise yet short enough to adapt as the day's vol regime shifts.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset at session open per day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from session open as the ATR channel center. No scaling needed — cumulative measure. Replaces the original's session_mean (simple SMA from open) because VWAP is the actual institutional execution benchmark; ATR channel crossings above/below VWAP have greater order-book significance than crossings of an arbitrary SMA.

indicators.name: upper_channel
indicators.purpose: Breakout threshold above VWAP. Preserves the original's 2.0 ATR multiplier — statistically 2 ATR from VWAP represents ~2-sigma deviation given the day's volatility, filtering noise-driven crossings.

indicators.name: lower_channel
indicators.purpose: Breakdown threshold below VWAP, symmetric to upper channel.

indicators.name: sma_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute simple moving average as trend direction filter, replacing the original's ADX(14). ADX at 5-second bar resolution is extremely noisy — the directional index requires 3x smoothing periods and lags too much at this frequency. SMA(60) price position (close above/below) is a robust directional filter: buy CE only when price is in an uptrend at the 5-min scale, buy PE only when in a downtrend.

indicators.name: vol_ratio
indicators.purpose: Current 5s bar volume relative to 5-minute average. Ratio > 1.3 confirms the breakout bar has elevated institutional participation vs random spikes. Period compressed from original's 20-bar 1-min (20-min baseline) to 60-bar 5s (5-min baseline) to match the ATR period and detect same-regime volume surges.

conditions: atr_ratio > 1.2 (ATR expanding above 10-min baseline — vol expansion confirmed)
close > sma_60 (price above 5-min SMA — uptrend at trigger timeframe)
vol_ratio > 1.3 (breakout bar volume elevated vs 5-min average)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions met simultaneously on the same 5s bar close

conditions: close < sma_60 (price below 5-min SMA — downtrend at trigger timeframe)
buy_pe.confirmation: All four conditions met simultaneously on the same 5s bar close

exit.stop_rationale: A valid NIFTY ATR channel breakout should not retrace 8-10 spot points within the first 30 seconds — 4 option points (~8 spot pts at delta 0.5) is the maximum tolerable pullback before declaring the breakout a false signal. Calibrated against typical NIFTY 30s moves of 2-5 option pts; a 4-pt adverse move means the breakout has already fully reversed.
exit.target_rationale: First-leg continuation of a NIFTY ATM channel breakout driven by institutional flow typically extends 14-20 spot points within 60-90 seconds; 7 option points (~14 spot pts) captures the median first-leg and gives 1:1.75 risk-reward against the 4-point stop. Consistent with the 1-2 min NIFTY move reference of 3-7 option pts for the stop and 5-10 pts for the full move.

filters.vix_filter: none — ATR expansion ratio serves as the internal volatility gate; VIX is externally correlated but not needed
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST; skip 09:15-09:25 for VWAP and ATR warmup
filters.trend_filter: close vs sma_60 for directional alignment
filters.spread_filter: limit orders — no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — 2.0x ATR multiplier may need periodic recalibration; ATR expansion ratio filter reduces false breakout rate substantially

adaptation_notes: Original ran on 1-min bars of individual NIFTY 50 equity constituents. Key changes: (1) ATR period compressed from 14-min to 5-min (60 bars at 5s) — our 15-120s hold requires current-regime vol, not a 14-min lag. (2) Channel center changed from session_mean (plain SMA from open) to cumulative VWAP — institutional benchmark is VWAP, not arithmetic mean. (3) ADX(14) trend filter replaced with SMA(60) price position — ADX is unreliable at 5-second frequency. (4) Volume ratio baseline compressed from 20-bar 1-min (20 min) to 60-bar 5s (5 min) to match ATR period. (5) Hold time compressed from 15-60 min to 15-120 seconds — only the initial breakout continuation is captured, not the full trend.
weaknesses: NIFTY 5s breakout bars are brief; ATR channel crossings can trigger on single-bar institutional spikes that reverse within 10s before the 5-stop fires
In high-VIX sessions (VIX > 22), the 2.0 * ATR channel widens dramatically and breakout signals become very infrequent, reducing daily trade count
VWAP diverges from spot price as the session progresses; late-day channels (14:30+) may already be far from current price range, generating stale threshold levels

_source.original_stop: 1.0 * ATR_14 from entry OR price re-enters channel
